# Impact X UI

> Multi-DS, multi-theme React component library distributed via CLI shadcn-style.

## Setup

- CLI interativo: `npx @impactx/ui`
- Instalar DS completo: `npx @impactx/ui add education`
- Instalar componente especifico: `npx @impactx/ui add education button`
- Instalar com theme: `npx @impactx/ui add education --alfabeto`
- Update: `npx @impactx/ui update education [<component>]`
- Listar: `npx @impactx/ui list`
- Diff local vs remoto: `npx @impactx/ui diff education button`
- Source canonico: github.com/impactx/impactx-ui
- Docs: ui.impactx.com.br

## Design Systems

- **education** — 22 atoms/molecules + 10 organisms domain-specific (gestao educacional)

## Themes (ortogonais ao DS)

- **alfabeto** — primary `#0467DB`
- **kumon** — primary `#00A9E3`
- **impactx** — primary `#11C76F` + tertiary `#F5C400`

## Convencoes

- Tokens via CSS vars (`var(--color-primary)`), nunca hex hardcoded
- Theme: `<html className="theme-alfabeto">` (ou `theme-kumon` / `theme-impactx`)
- Mode: `<html data-mode="dark">` (light eh default sem `data-mode`)
- Componentes consomem so tokens — DS eh agnostico ao theme
- ESM only, TypeScript strict
- DataTable headless — Pagination compoem externo

## Decisoes de design fechadas

- Outline buttons usam `border-2` da intent color (nao cinza)
- Helper text de Input usa primary color (nao muted)
- Toast bg eh tinted da intent (nao branco/preto puro)
- Tertiary buttons no theme `impactx` = amarelo `#F5C400`
- Theme switching via classe HTML, mode via atributo HTML
- Schema do registry estende `https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json` com `meta.impactx`

## Stack

- pnpm workspaces + turbo
- Next 16 + React 19 + Tailwind v4
- @clack/prompts (CLI), picocolors (cores)
- Vitest (testes)

## Estrutura

- `apps/web/` — showcase + docs Next
- `packages/cli/` — `@impactx/ui` CLI
- `packages/ds-education/` — DS canonico
- `scripts/` — build-registry, check-cohesion
